真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 27 页

Q30：Choose A–D. Q37–40：Do the statements agree with the views of the writer? YES / NO / NOT GIVEN。

原文第6段But sugar production was never just a matter of agriculture. It also involved the extraction, close to the place of harvest, of sucrose from the sugar plant, a process which required machinery powered by humans, animals, wind or steam. Further processes involved boiling (from the 19th century, this often involved vacuum systems) and the separation of sugar from other materials in a process known as refinement. From very early on, sugar production was an energy-intensive industrial process, mostly taking place in the countryside and in refineries in centres of consumption, both small and large. The growth of the industry entailed a very rapid diffusion of ideas and techniques from one country to another. Cuba, for example, developed an extraordinarily dense system of railways to transport workers and cane, as well as steam-powered sugar factories. Particular varieties of cane sugar and beet sugar spread very rapidly across the world, in accordance with local needs and demands.

原文第7段Where once only tiny quantities of sugar could be produced, now new techniques, varieties, fertilisers, irrigation systems and much more have turned gleaming white sugar into a ubiquitous chemical. Over the same time, there has been a massive increase in consumption. Once regarded as a luxury, sugar came to be promoted as a valuable source of energy. But as the consumption of sugar has increased, so has the harm it does, whether to people's teeth or weight. In the face of appalling obstruction from the sugar industry to attempts to reduce consumption, some countries have been forced to tax sugar in order to bring that about. The sugar industry has a history of attacking its critics and, when it comes to obesity, of trying to blame fats, and lack of exercise and self-control. And the recent past has seen worrying new developments in mass sweetening. High-fructose corn syrup made from maize using an enzymatic process invented in Japan in the 1960s has a similar number of calories to table sugar but is far cheaper to produce. It is now widely consumed, having been adopted in the making of soft drinks and a large number of processed foods, and is regarded as a leading cause of obesity.

原文第8段This is a wonderfully rich book, a model of global history, the history of production and the history of capitalism. Bosma avoids outbursts of emotion, celebratory or critical, even if they might have made his analysis of the multiple tragedies involving sugar all the more powerful. He shows that we could always have done without sugar and that today we have many alternative sources of sweetness. Yet many of the poorest people in the world still depend on it to make a living.

30. In the final paragraph, what does the reviewer suggest is the overall message of Bosma's book?

A Sugar is a harmful and unnecessary product.
B Economic pressure is needed to control sugar production.
C Conditions for workers in sugar production should be improved.
D Intensive marketing of sugar has had disastrous consequences.
第 30 题作答

第 37 题作答

38. Advertisers initially marketed sugar as a luxury product.

第 38 题作答

39. The invention of high-fructose corn syrup was a positive development.

第 39 题作答

40. High-fructose corn syrup is an ingredient in many processed foods.

材料精读 · 内容与词句

书评从糖的种植转向提炼、能源和技术传播，再追踪大规模生产如何与消费增长及健康争议相连。结尾保留一个现实张力：人们可以减少对糖的依赖，但许多贫困生产者仍依靠糖业谋生。

原文第6段
But sugar production was never just a matter of agriculture. It also involved the extraction, close to the place of harvest, of sucrose from the sugar plant, a process which required machinery powered by humans, animals, wind or steam. Further processes involved boiling (from the 19th century, this often involved vacuum systems) and the separation of sugar from other materials in a process known as refinement. From very early on, sugar production was an energy-intensive industrial process, mostly taking place in the countryside and in refineries in centres of consumption, both small and large. The growth of the industry entailed a very rapid diffusion of ideas and techniques from one country to another. Cuba, for example, developed an extraordinarily dense system of railways to transport workers and cane, as well as steam-powered sugar factories. Particular varieties of cane sugar and beet sugar spread very rapidly across the world, in accordance with local needs and demands.

糖不仅是农作物，还需要提取蔗糖、煮制和精炼，这些环节很早就依赖机械与能源。生产既在乡村进行，也在消费中心的精炼厂进行。行业扩张还推动技术、品种和运输设施跨国传播，古巴的密集铁路与蒸汽糖厂是例子。作者借此打破农业与工业截然分开的想象，同时强调不同地方会按照自身需要采用技术。

原文第7段
Where once only tiny quantities of sugar could be produced, now new techniques, varieties, fertilisers, irrigation systems and much more have turned gleaming white sugar into a ubiquitous chemical. Over the same time, there has been a massive increase in consumption. Once regarded as a luxury, sugar came to be promoted as a valuable source of energy. But as the consumption of sugar has increased, so has the harm it does, whether to people's teeth or weight. In the face of appalling obstruction from the sugar industry to attempts to reduce consumption, some countries have been forced to tax sugar in order to bring that about. The sugar industry has a history of attacking its critics and, when it comes to obesity, of trying to blame fats, and lack of exercise and self-control. And the recent past has seen worrying new developments in mass sweetening. High-fructose corn syrup made from maize using an enzymatic process invented in Japan in the 1960s has a similar number of calories to table sugar but is far cheaper to produce. It is now widely consumed, having been adopted in the making of soft drinks and a large number of processed foods, and is regarded as a leading cause of obesity.

新的技术、品种、肥料和灌溉使糖从少量奢侈品变成普遍消费品，也被宣传为能量来源。书评随后转向消费增加带来的牙齿和体重问题，以及糖业阻挠减糖、转移责任的争议。末尾介绍高果糖玉米糖浆：热量与食糖相近，生产成本却低得多，因此被广泛用于饮料和加工食品；作者也转述了其与肥胖有关的评价。这是书评中的论述，不能把所有体重问题归于单一成分，也不能把文中now和recent past当成今日实时信息。

原文第8段
This is a wonderfully rich book, a model of global history, the history of production and the history of capitalism. Bosma avoids outbursts of emotion, celebratory or critical, even if they might have made his analysis of the multiple tragedies involving sugar all the more powerful. He shows that we could always have done without sugar and that today we have many alternative sources of sweetness. Yet many of the poorest people in the world still depend on it to make a living.

结尾高度评价全书的全球史、生产史和资本主义史视角，同时指出Bosma克制了赞颂或批判的情绪表达。作者认为更强烈的情绪可能增强悲剧分析的冲击力，这是一种书评判断。最后的Yet重新引入生产者：即使消费者有其他甜味来源，许多穷人仍靠糖业生活，因此减少消费与保障生计需要一起被看见。

词语与搭配
an energy-intensive industrial process

一种耗能密集的工业过程

energy-intensive说明单位活动需要较多能源，industrial process指多环节加工；不能仅因原料来自农田就忽略加工环节。

in accordance with local needs and demands

依照当地需要与需求

in accordance with表示与某种要求一致；这里说明技术和品种的传播并非各地完全相同。

a massive increase in consumption

消费的大幅增加

increase in后接发生增长的指标；massive是强程度词，实际写作中应与有依据的规模判断相配。

a valuable source of energy

一种有价值的能量来源

在本文中位于was promoted as之后，属于曾经的宣传定位，不等同于作者无条件推荐增加糖摄入。

depend on it to make a living

依靠它谋生

depend on说明经济依赖，to make a living解释依赖的目的；it指糖及糖业相关生产。

句子精读
It also involved the extraction, close to the place of harvest, of sucrose from the sugar plant, a process which required machinery powered by humans, animals, wind or steam.

糖的生产还包括在收获地点附近从糖料作物中提取蔗糖，这个过程需要由人力、畜力、风力或蒸汽驱动的机械。

It指糖的生产。extraction of sucrose from the sugar plant是一个完整名词结构，中间插入close to the place of harvest补充地点；a process是对提取活动的同位说明。which修饰process，powered by...是过去分词短语修饰machinery，列出动力来源而非四个必须依次经过的阶段。

In the face of appalling obstruction from the sugar industry to attempts to reduce consumption, some countries have been forced to tax sugar in order to bring that about.

面对糖业对降低消费努力的严重阻挠，一些国家不得不对糖征税，以促成消费的减少。

In the face of引出阻力背景；from the sugar industry说明阻挠来自谁，to attempts...说明受到阻挠的是哪类尝试。主干是some countries have been forced to tax sugar。that回指reduce consumption，in order to表达政策目的，不能单凭这个目的就判断政策效果已经实现。appalling保留了书评的批评态度。

这篇材料里可用于写作的表达
attempts to reduce consumption

降低消费量的努力

在健康话题里要补清consumption指什么，例如含糖饮料，而不是笼统主张减少所有食品消费。适合描述措施与商业激励之间的关系。

用于写作：儿童肥胖题要求提出措施；这句话把减少含糖饮料摄入与可负担替代品联系起来，强调环境支持而非只责怪个人自控。

a large number of processed foods

大量加工食品

可讨论配方、标签或食品环境，但加工食品并非全部有相同营养特征，例句应限定要比较的成分。
